title: Right and Left
label: ch:mr-right-and-left
canDo: I can name the right and left sides with an adjective that agrees with its noun, and I can run every place word in the book off one bent stem.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R44-directions and bend ghar once, then run madhye, var, khālī, javaḷ and samor off that single stem before adding a side with ujvā or ḍāvā.
payoff.note: The payoff is the whole place column run once off one stem, not the two sides this chapter introduces.
